title: Online AC1024 sample candidates for new-source qualification
scope: Locate candidate files for a second independent AC1024 input profile without admitting any file as a fixture or evidence before inspecting its bytes and provenance.

sources.title: Autodesk AutoCAD LT Sample Files
sources.evidence: Autodesk lists sample DWGs and says the sample set applies to AutoCAD LT 2010 and later.
sources.limitation: The page does not identify the saved DWG format version for each individual download.

sources.title: AutoCAD 2010 sample-file list and archive pointer
sources.evidence: The 2009 post identifies the listed files as AutoCAD 2010 samples and points to Autodesk's sample archive.
sources.limitation: Secondary historical source; it does not provide file hashes or verify that current archive bytes are unchanged.

qualificationGate: Download only to a scratch location and record URL, retrieval date, byte length and SHA-256.
Verify the first six bytes are AC1024 before treating a file as an AC1024 sample.
Check hashes against the existing local corpus so aliases do not count as independent sources.
Run current fast read/strict-output probes and independent reader comparison on eligible candidates.
Do not commit downloaded DWG or derived DXF fixtures; create a local-from-scratch fixture only if a minimized regression is needed.
result: Candidate locations were identified from Autodesk's archive and its historical AutoCAD 2010 sample list. The binary download endpoints were not fetched in this research pass; no candidate has an observed AC1024 signature, hash, reader result, or producer-qualification status.
